name: Die Macher

rounds.endCondition: After the 4th federal state election (5 rounds / 7 elections in the extended variant)

categories.label: Federal state election VP (votes + winner/coalition), total of all elections
categories.labelVi: VP bầu cử các bang (phiếu + thắng/liên minh), tổng cộng
categories.hint: From the scoring pad: VP for votes per state (min 5 votes), plus 12 for sole 50+ winner, 10 each if several reach 50+, 7 each for a coalition partner, 5 if no coalition.

categories.label: Media VP (media markers on the media board)
categories.hint: Sum of the VP shown on the media presence spot of each of your media markers.

categories.label: Party base VP
categories.hint: 1 VP per point on the party base scale.

categories.label: Leftover money
categories.hint: Only the two players with the most money score: 1st 6 VP, 2nd 3 VP. Enter your money in euros (or thousands).

tiebreakers.description: No tiebreaker found in the rulebook read.

notes: family: election-majority-plus-tracks. Verified from a rulebook of the newer edition (Spielworxx/Indie Game Studios, 4 elections); BGG id 1 is the 1986 Hans im Gluck edition and older editions (1997 Moskito, 2006 Valley) differ: 7 elections, extra VP when party platform matches national opinion, no money VP. Confirm which edition the club owns. All-full tie treatment for money is an assumption; rule says tied players each score the table value.
